name: Encore Radio
author: Nick Scilingo Nick S(NJ)
description: Keep the radio station feel going after the light show ends. Streams a custom internet radio URL, TuneIn stations, or a folder of music from a network share (free), or Pandora and Spotify playlists (premium), through your after-hours schedule. Premium also unlocks Source Rotation (a different source on a day/time schedule) and Source Fallback (auto-recovery if a source fails), with Announcement Assistant integration for scheduled station-style announcements.

privacy.summary: Streams your chosen station or shared library (free) or Pandora/Spotify (premium) through FPP. The 10-hour Pandora/Spotify trial is tracked entirely on this device and never reported anywhere - the license server is only ever contacted to validate a paid license key you've entered, and to relay Spotify's OAuth handshake during Spotify setup.

sends.what: a hardware ID (CPU serial/machine-id) and the license key you entered; also relays the Spotify OAuth authorization code and this device's local callback URL during Spotify setup, since Spotify only accepts an https redirect URI and this device's LAN address can't be one
sends.why: validating a paid license key against the device it was entered on, and completing Spotify's OAuth handshake

sends.to: the custom stream URL you enter
sends.what: an HTTP request to start playback of that stream

sends.to: the TuneIn station's actual stream host (resolved via opml.radiotime.com's Tune.ashx)
sends.what: an HTTP request to start playback of that station's stream
the CIFS/SMB username and password you configure, and file read requests
your Spotify account tokens and search/playback requests

sends.to: Pandora's servers (via the bundled pianobar client)
sends.what: your Pandora login and playback requests

sends.to: Spotify's servers (via the bundled Raspotify/librespot service)
sends.what: this device's online status, for Spotify Connect discovery
sends.why: lets your Spotify app find and cast to this device

collects.what: an optional registration email (not required for anything - kept only for the operator's own reference) and license key/status
cumulative premium (Pandora/Spotify) trial seconds used - tracked entirely locally, never sent anywhere, and freely resettable by editing or deleting this file
Spotify client ID/secret and access/refresh tokens

collects.where: plugindata/fpp-EncoreRadio/encoreradio.json (mode 600), and briefly in plugindata/fpp-EncoreRadio/netshare_creds (mode 600, rewritten each time the share is mounted)

systemChanges.what: creates and enables encoreradio-pulse.service, a system-wide PulseAudio instance; overwrites /etc/pulse/system.pa (backed up and restored on uninstall) and writes /home/fpp/.config/pulse/client.conf pointing the fpp user's PulseAudio clients - including FPP's own audio output - at that system instance
enables and starts the Raspotify (Spotify Connect) systemd service once the operator configures Spotify (premium); not started for operators who never use the Spotify source
adds the pulse and fpp users to the audio group
downloads and installs the Raspotify .deb release from dtcooper.github.io, checksum-verified via api.github.com
edits /etc/raspotify/conf (backend/device name) when Raspotify is installed
mounts an operator-specified network share (CIFS/SMB) on demand for the Network Share source, at /run/fpp-EncoreRadio-netshare (outside media/, unmounted when playback stops)
the audio relay binds 0.0.0.0:8123 (configurable) while a source is playing

privacy.other: Uninstalling does not remove plugindata/fpp-EncoreRadio/ (encoreradio.json, trial_state.json) or the plugin's state directory: registration status, license data, trial-hour progress, and any saved Pandora/Spotify/network-share credentials remain on disk until deleted by hand. Uninstalling also does not remove the raspotify package or /etc/raspotify/conf (so a reinstall doesn't need to re-download it), and never touches the shared PulseAudio service/config if another installed plugin (e.g. Announcement Assistant) may also depend on it.
